name: ogbn-proteins: Protein-Protein Association Network
description: The ogbn-proteins dataset is an undirected, weighted, multi-relational graph representing protein-protein associations across 8 species extracted from the STRING database. Nodes represent proteins (132,534 nodes), and edges represent 8 types of biological associations (totaling 39,561,252 edges) with 8-dimensional edge features reflecting interaction confidence. The task is multi-label protein function prediction across 112 Gene Ontology (GO) terms, evaluated by average ROC-AUC under a species-based out-of-distribution split.
